Episode Notes:
Steve talks with Wyatt Frasier and Kaylee Bosinger of Sitreps, the recruiting firm and online community built to help service members navigate life after the military. A West Point graduate and Wharton MBA, Frasier co-founded Sitreps, where Bosinger now leads the talent work, placing veterans into defense tech and private equity roles. Together, they take apart the fears, bad advice, and outright scams that cloud the decision to leave, and lay out what actually separates the veterans who thrive from those who flounder.
